args.body: Take PUBLIC-TABLE-EXTRACTION-REQUEST. Seek one actual document-data problem before producing a sample. This is independent of the parked Shopify and procurement offers; do not reopen those or scan paid-work platforms. Check source access and reuse first, stop after three candidates, and produce the requested small result only if justified. Missing automated collection blocks paid acceptance, not permitted offline preparation. Do not claim acquisition from a saved artifact. Three unclassified feedback sources remain unknown demand; preserve existing live experiment deadlines.

description: Payment readiness has changed: an Interac CAD route is configured, but actual order acceptance requires an operator and no eligible request is observed. Feedback remains uncertain: three sources are unclassified, so zero classified requests does not establish zero demand. Existing Shopify and award offers have evidence against further paid packaging. Test a distinct, bounded document-data service against an actual public request before building; advertised prices remain neither funding nor revenue.
